image_manifest.description: A 3D rendered asset manifest showing the aerial Pterosaur Racing Referee at the finish line, celebrating the winning pterosaur from her hang glider.

assets.name: Pterosaur Race Referee
assets.description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist with braided black hair and African ethnicity (dino_bones_paleontologist_6). She is wearing a bright yellow aerial safety helmet with strap details, a white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts, and black hiking boots. She is seated safely in a harness attached to a hang glider, beaming with a huge, joyful smile. She is holding a shiny gold trophy high in one hand and waving the checkered flag in her other hand.

assets.name: Hang Glider
assets.description: A high-visibility, lightweight hang glider with a bright yellow and red wing frame keeping the referee safely suspended mid-air at the finish line.

assets.name: Celebratory Items
assets.description: A large, gleaming golden trophy held triumphantly in one hand and a black-and-white checkered flag fluttering cheerfully in the other hand.

assets.name: Aerial Finish Line Environment
assets.description: High-altitude open sky near dramatic Cretaceous canyon cliffs with a festive floating archway marking the aerial finish line, under bright sunlight.

assets.name: Visual Effects
assets.description: Celebratory sparkling lens flares glinting off the gold trophy, wind swirl effects around the glider, and colorful confetti drifting in the updrafts.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent four-pointed star lens-flare logo located in the bottom-right corner.

image_manifest.constraints: No people other than the referee. Square aspect ratio, 1:1. Ensure safety helmet is clearly visible. No ID labels, text overlays, title bars, or borders.
